title: A first-quadrant spectral sequence concentrated in the row q = 0 collapses
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and let $(E_r^{p,q},d_r)_{r\ge2}$ be a first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence in $\mathcal A$: $E_2^{p,q}=0$ unless $p\ge0$ and $q\ge0$, $d_r:E_r^{p,q}\to E_r^{p+r,q-r+1}$, $d_r\circ d_r=0$ and $E_{r+1}\cong\ker d_r/\operatorname{im}d_r$. Suppose it converges to a sequence of objects $(H^n)_{n\ge0}$ of $\mathcal A$: each $H^n$ carries a finite decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration] $H^n=F^0H^n\supseteq F^1H^n\supseteq\dots\supseteq F^{n+1}H^n=0$ with $F^pH^n/F^{p+1}H^n\cong E_\infty^{p,n-p}$, where $E_\infty^{p,q}=E_r^{p,q}$ for $r>\max(p,q+1)$. If $E_2^{p,q}=0$ for every $q>0$, then for every $n\ge0$ the edge map $E_2^{n,0}=E_\infty^{n,0}=F^nH^n\hookrightarrow H^n$ is an isomorphism $E_2^{n,0}\cong H^n$. In particular, if moreover $H^n=0$ for every $n>0$, then $E_2^{n,0}=0$ for every $n>0$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-spectral-page-zero-propagation] to the first-quadrant and upper-row hypotheses. Thus $E_r^{p,q}=0$ for $p<0$ or $q\ne0$ on every page $r\ge2$, and every positive-row stable term vanishes.

source.place: Tags 011N (definition-spectral-sequence) and 0BDV (lemma-relate-boundedness), zero-entry propagation; the supplied row-support hypotheses are the base case.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-stationary-bottom-row] to the all-page support from Step 1. Take its isomorphisms a(n,r): E_2^(n,0) ≅ E_(r+2)^(n,0), whose initial value is the identity. Its bottom-row conclusion makes each actual cycle inclusion i_r invertible. Define b(n,r)=a(n,r).hom followed by the inverse cycle inclusion. Inverse cancellation gives b(n,r) followed by i_r equal to a(n,r).hom. The supplied consecutive comparison square, after cancelling i_r and a(n,r), gives b(n,r) followed by homology projection and the specified next-page isomorphism equal to a(n,r+1).hom. The page indices (r+1)+2 and r+3 agree. No separate short-complex lemma is needed in this assembly.

source.place: Tags 011N (definition-spectral-sequence), 011O (definition-limit-spectral-sequence), 0BDV (lemma-relate-boundedness): stationary comparisons and their cycle/homology maps.

proof.text: Fix n≥0. For every integer 0≤p<n, let k=p.toNat and q=n-k. Then k+q=n, q>0 and k=p as integers. Step 1 gives E_(n+2)^(k,q)=0; transport this along the supplied convergence isomorphism to obtain gr^p(F n)=0. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-filtration-last-piece] with the supplied endpoint conditions, A=E_2^(n,0), B=E_(n+2)^(n,0), a=a(n,n) from Step 2, and c=conv(n,n,0). Take its unique lift f and its isomorphism e:A≅H n. The canonical quotient identity for rho identifies the lift equation with the required equation, and the canonical inclusion identity for j identifies e.hom with f followed by the inclusion. Thus that composite is invertible. The same lemma gives IsZero(H n) → IsZero(A), which proves the positive-degree vanishing corollary. This applies also to n=0, when the range 0≤p<n is empty.
